Package dev.oumaimaa.kawaiiapi.items

Class ItemUtils.ItemBuilder

java.lang.Object
dev.oumaimaa.kawaiiapi.items.ItemUtils.ItemBuilder
Enclosing class:
ItemUtils
public static final class ItemUtils.ItemBuilder extends Object
Builder class for creating complex items with a fluent API. Provides method chaining for convenient item construction.
